request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBACT04C-001: Category balances are processed in account groups (control break on account ID)

### given[0]: Category balance records are read one at a time from the indexed category balance file, in key order. The key starts with the account ID, so all categories for one account come in together.
fields=['TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD', 'TRANCAT-ACCT-ID'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   321                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   322            END-IF
   323            EXIT.
   324       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
>> 325        1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT.
>> 326            READ TCATBAL-FILE INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD.
   327            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '00'
   328                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   329            ELSE
   330                IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '10'
CVTRA01Y.cpy:
     1       *****************************************************************
     2       *    Data-structure for transaction category balance (RECLN = 50)
     3       *****************************************************************
>>   4        01  TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD.
>>   5            05  TRAN-CAT-KEY.
>>   6               10 TRANCAT-ACCT-ID                       PIC 9(11).
>>   7               10 TRANCAT-TYPE-CD                       PIC X(02).
>>   8               10 TRANCAT-CD                            PIC 9(04).
>>   9            05  TRAN-CAT-BAL                            PIC S9(09)V99.
    10            05  FILLER                                  PIC X(22).
    11       *
    12       * Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:16:00 CDT
    13       *

### given[1]: At program start the last-seen account number is spaces and the first-time flag is 'Y'.
fields=['WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM', 'WS-FIRST-TIME'] literals=['Y']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   162            06 DB2-SS                    PIC X(002).
   163            06 DB2-DOT-3                 PIC X.
   164            06 DB2-MIL                   PIC 9(002).
   165            06 DB2-REST                  PIC X(04).
>> 166        01 WS-MISC-VARS.
>> 167            05 WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM          PIC X(11) VALUE SPACES.
>> 168            05 WS-MONTHLY-INT            PIC S9(09)V99.
>> 169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
>> 170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.
   172            05 WS-RECORD-COUNT           PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   173            05 WS-TRANID-SUFFIX          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
   174 

### when[0]: A category balance record is read and its account ID differs from the last-seen account number.
fields=['END-OF-FILE', 'TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM'] literals=['N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   187 
   188            PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
   189                IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
>> 191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
>> 192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
>> 193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
>> 194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
   196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   197                        ELSE
   198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME

### then[0]: If this is not the first account group, the account loaded before is updated with its accumulated interest and rewritten (1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT). On the first group the first-time flag is just set to 'N'.
fields=['WS-FIRST-TIME'] literals=['Y', 'N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
>> 195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
>> 196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
>> 197                        ELSE
>> 198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
>> 199                        END-IF
   200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA

### then[1]: The interest total is reset to 0 and the last-seen account number is set to the new account ID.
fields=['WS-TOTAL-INT', 'WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM', 'TRANCAT-ACCT-ID'] literals=['0']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   197                        ELSE
   198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
   199                        END-IF
>> 200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
>> 201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA
   204                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
   205                        PERFORM 1110-GET-XREF-DATA

### then[2]: The account record for the new account ID is read by key from the account file into ACCOUNT-RECORD.
fields=['TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'FD-ACCT-ID', 'ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
   199                        END-IF
   200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
>> 202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA
   204                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
   205                        PERFORM 1110-GET-XREF-DATA
   206                      END-IF
   207       *              DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID: ' ACCT-GROUP-ID
CBACT04C.cbl:
   368                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   369            END-IF
   370            EXIT.
   371       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
>> 372        1100-GET-ACCT-DATA.
>> 373            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
>> 374                INVALID KEY
>> 375                   DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT NOT FOUND: ' FD-ACCT-ID
>> 376            END-READ
   377 
   378            IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS  = '00'
   379                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   380            ELSE

### then[3]: The card cross-reference for the account is read through the account-ID alternate key. This supplies the card number that later goes on the interest transactions.
fields=['TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'FD-XREF-ACCT-ID', 'CARD-XREF-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA
>> 204                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
>> 205                        PERFORM 1110-GET-XREF-DATA
   206                      END-IF
   207       *              DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID: ' ACCT-GROUP-ID
   208       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-CD: ' TRANCAT-CD
   209       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD: ' TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
CBACT04C.cbl:
   389                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   390            END-IF
   391            EXIT.
   392       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
>> 393        1110-GET-XREF-DATA.
>> 394            READ XREF-FILE INTO CARD-XREF-RECORD
>> 395             KEY IS FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
>> 396                INVALID KEY
>> 397                   DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT NOT FOUND: ' FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
>> 398            END-READ
   399 
   400            IF  XREFFILE-STATUS   = '00'
   401                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   402            ELSE

### then[4]: For every category balance record, whether or not the account changed, the rate lookup key is built from the account's group ID and the record's category code and type code, and the interest rate is looked up.
fields=['ACCT-GROUP-ID', 'FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID', 'TRANCAT-CD', 'FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD', 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD', 'FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   206                      END-IF
   207       *              DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID: ' ACCT-GROUP-ID
   208       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-CD: ' TRANCAT-CD
   209       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD: ' TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
>> 210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
>> 211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
>> 212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
>> 213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
   214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
   215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
   216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
   217                      END-IF

### then[5]: Interest is calculated (and the fee step run) only when the interest rate found is not zero. Records with a zero rate add nothing to the account's interest total.
fields=['DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=['0']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
   211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
   212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
   213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
>> 214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
>> 215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
>> 216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
>> 217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
   219                ELSE
   220                     PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   221                END-IF

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":false,"reason":"The cited lines show a READ of TCATBAL-FILE and a key that starts with TRANCAT-ACCT-ID, but nothing cited shows the file is indexed or read sequentially in key order, so the grouping claim is not established."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM is declared with VALUE SPACES and WS-FIRST-TIME with VALUE 'Y'."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 191-194 test END-OF-FILE = 'N' after the read and then compare TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":false,"reason":"The cited lines show 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT is performed when WS-FIRST-TIME is not 'Y' (otherwise the flag is set to 'N'), but they do not show that the paragraph applies accumulated interest or rewrites the account."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 200-201 move 0 to WS-TOTAL-INT and move TRANCAT-ACCT-ID to WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":true,"reason":"TRANCAT-ACCT-ID is moved to FD-ACCT-ID and 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA does a keyed READ of ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD."},{"clause":"then[3]","supported":false,"reason":"The keyed read on FD-XREF-ACCT-ID is shown, but the cited lines do not show the card number being used later on interest transactions."},{"clause":"then[4]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 210-213 sit after the account-change IF block and build the rate key from ACCT-GROUP-ID, TRANCAT-CD and TRANCAT-TYPE-CD before performing 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE for every record read."},{"clause":"then[5]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 214-217 perform 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST and 1400-COMPUTE-FEES only when DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0, so zero-rate records skip the interest computation."}]}
